chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 538: Han Li Breaks Through to Mid-Core Formation After 15 Years of Seclusion – A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality
chapter_meta_description: Han Li emerges from fifteen years of seclusion having broken through to mid-Core Formation, but new trouble approaches the Fog Sea in the form of fleeing cultivators. A true calm-before-the-storm chapter.

og_description: Fifteen years of solitary cultivation yield a breakthrough to mid-Core Formation, but the Fog Sea will not stay silent for long.
twitter_title: RMJI 538: Han Li Rises to Mid-Core Formation After 15 Years—But Trouble Arrives!
twitter_description: Han Li's quiet seclusion is shattered by fleeing cultivators. The Fog Sea's hidden island is about to become a battlefield.

lore_anchors.definition: A spiritual herb once used by Han Li to stimulate aggression and reproduction in his Gold Devourer Beetles; it has now lost its potency for the evolved tri-colored batch, forcing him to conserve the beetles as a depleting resource.
An ancient insect species ranked on the Strange Insect List; Han Li’s evolved tri-colored beetles are powerful but can no longer be bred through Rainbow Tail Grass, making them a finite asset.
A vast, mist-covered sea region near Han Li’s hidden cave; a classic xianxia setting where visibility is low and danger can arrive without warning.
A mineral rich in spiritual energy used by cultivators to accelerate mana recovery; the fleeing cultivators clutch them during their desperate meditation attempt.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Rainbow Tail Grass stop working on the tri-colored beetles?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The novel does not fully explain the mechanism, but the implication is that evolved Gold Devourer Beetles have outgrown the herb’s effects; in Mortal Stream logic, this is a systemic resource ceiling that forces the protagonist to adapt.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How long was Han Li in seclusion total?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He spent the first ~3 years on alchemy, then ~15–16 years in secluded cultivation—so roughly 18 to 19 years have passed since he first entered the alchemy chamber.
